method: Lexical/source candidate review plus objective comparison with the pilot and earlier batches. Similarity is only a review aid, not proof of semantic uniqueness.

records.reason: Nullable return chaining differs from detecting uninitialized typed-property storage; neither remedy substitutes for the other.
SELECT result counting differs from delayed bindParam reference capture; PDO setup accounts for the source overlap.
Result cardinality inspection differs from selecting a SQL identifier through an allowlist.
Caller-versus-definition file strictness differs from an internal callback call boundary; return coercion is central only in 0320.
Chunked encoder state differs from append-mode cursor behavior; shared file setup is incidental.

The archived strict-call example is extended with weak-file return coercion, testing two independently controlled boundaries instead of only caller arguments.
Create-without-truncation and create-only-if-absent require different modes and opposite treatment of existing files.

Generator rewind legality depends on advancement; exception injection delegates control into a different generator.
Nested array copying concerns storage independence; parallel-array sorting concerns coordinated ordering.

Readonly promotion causes a forbidden second assignment; a set hook changes the stored value while an assignment expression returns its input.

Flipped-key collision rules do not involve boolean assignment precedence.
Recursive replacement resolves existing nested keys; flipping turns values into keys and loses duplicate values.
Magic fallback for an inaccessible method differs from state in an invokable callback object.
A failed string conversion interrupts its enclosing echo; recursive output order follows entry and unwind phases.
Array flipping changes key/value roles; assigning an object retains identity rather than copying it.
Variadic unpacked references modify the source array; generator cleanup concerns lifetime and finalization.
strtok owns one shared continuation state; Closure static locals are associated with the particular Closure instance.
Natural sorting compares digit runs; half-even rounding selects a numeric midpoint rule.
A shorthand conditional avoids a repeated side-effecting call; octal syntax determines a literal value.
Slash division’s result type differs from string-to-array-key normalization.
Reference variadics update unpacked source elements; foreach does not advance an array’s internal pointer.
Constructor-free allocation leaves promoted storage uninitialized; explicitly initialized readonly null is already a completed initialization.
Source integer literal syntax and array-key normalization treat leading zeros in different representations and contexts.
Throwing during conversion interrupts an expression; throwing into a delegated generator can be caught and yield a recovery value.
Method accessibility can trigger __call; interface membership is a nominal type relation.
Cross-file scalar coercion boundaries are unrelated to global constants and local variables.
Cycle collection releases a self-reference; overloaded property access returns either a value copy or an object handle.
Explicit garbage collection and loop condition placement have distinct control mechanisms.
Pairing two parallel lists uses array_combine; extracting fields from records uses array_column with an index field.

The archive combines capture timing with a static function counter. The new record isolates local mutation of a value-captured scalar across invocations: unlike a static counter, the local increment is not retained.
A callback’s local key variable cannot rename array keys; SensitiveParameter redaction concerns stack arguments rather than explicit messages.

An ordinary array default and a captured scalar both provide starting values, but the new question addresses the misconception that a Closure object automatically retains local scalar mutations. It has no default parameter.
Nested array copy independence does not involve null-coalescing assignment or lazy right operands.
String conversion can throw before echo; match conditions and result expressions have selective evaluation without conversion hooks.
Returning a match result addresses function flow; the archived example tests match’s strict selection rule.

HTTP method tokens are case-sensitive while header field names are case-insensitive; the opposed protocol rules require distinct behavior.

Octal source syntax and pre/postcondition loops have no shared reasoning requirement.

Static local counters belong to Closure instances; a value-captured scalar locally incremented on each invocation does not become such a counter. The observations test the opposed storage mechanisms explicitly.

The earlier deep-copy test requires termination on cycles. This acyclic graph test requires preserving sharing between two edges; a copier can terminate and copy every value yet violate that identity relation.

The pilot tests an omitted function argument versus an explicit null value. This partial-update design carries field presence through validation and DTO boundaries while preserving an explicit empty string as a third operation.

A confirmed aborted serialization attempt permits a full fresh transaction retry. The earlier uncertain-commit case requires determining durable outcome rather than blindly replaying a potentially committed operation.
